raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stack (1/6), merge in order: [#44851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44851) → [#44852](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44852) → [#44853](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44853) → [#44854](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44854) → [#44863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44863) → [#44869](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44869)

## Motivation

Gemma4 text serving currently loads vision/audio encoders that it never uses. Enable `--language-model-only` while preserving the processor's tokenizer configuration, including BOS handling.

## Modifications

- Omit media towers and skip their checkpoint weights for text-only launches.
- Reuse Gemma4's processor tokenizer so identical text retains identical token IDs; preserve the existing tokenizer loader for other architectures.
- Add text-only XPU coverage for generation, token-ID parity, and media rejection, plus an E2B/BMG cookbook recipe.

This is encoder omission, not CPU offload. The existing CPU-offload work in #44139 is excluded from this branch.

## Accuracy Tests

On an Intel Arc Pro B70 with the original `google/gemma-4-E2B-it` weights: full-model and text-only generation tests, processor-tokenizer parity, and media rejection pass. Prior 200-example GSM8K smoke runs scored 78.5% for both modes; this is not a statistical quality-equivalence claim.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

At TP1 and `--mem-fraction-static 0.70`, reported weight allocation decreases from 9.94 to 9.04 GB. Full-attention KV capacity increases from 353,920 to 382,528 tokens (8.1%). No weight quantization is involved.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit checks.
- [x] XPU serving and tokenization tests.
- [x] Cookbook update, Mintlify validation and broken-link checks.
- [x] Accuracy and memory measurements.

Base of the Gemma4 serving optimization stack.

+def get_text_tokenizer(tokenizer_name: str, *, model_architectures=(), **kwargs):
+    """Load a standalone tokenizer without changing a multimodal model's tokens.
+
+    Gemma4's processor and direct tokenizer loaders configure BOS differently.
+    Reuse the processor's tokenizer when omitting its encoders so the same text
+    still produces the same input IDs. Loading a processor builds no model tower.
+    """
+    if "Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration" in (model_architectures or ()):
+        return get_tokenizer_from_processor(get_processor(tokenizer_name, **kwargs))
+    return get_tokenizer(tokenizer_name, **kwargs)

+class TestGemma4E2BTextOnlyXPU(TestGemma4E2BXPU):
+    """The text-only launch must omit media capability and reject media inputs."""
+
+    server_args = XPU_SERVER_ARGS + [
+        "--language-model-only",

+    def test_preserves_processor_token_ids(self):

+                "image_data": "data:image/png;base64,AA==",
+                "sampling_params": {"max_new_tokens": 1},
+            },
+            timeout=30,
+        )

+        self.assertIn("--language-model-only", response.text)
